## JobRadar — be one of the first applicants
**Find** new roles minutes after they go live (company job boards + remote boards) → **screen** them against your search profile with Claude → **tailor** your resume and cover letter from your own files → **check** the AI didn't invent anything → **notify** you with the files and an Apply button.

A human always submits. You edit `settings.json` and `candidate/`, not this workflow.
